name: glances
reportsTo: passive: the sink polls /api/4/all at Glances' refresh period
footnotes: Glances ships no systemd unit; the harness adds a two-line one that runs `glances -w`.
Runs as root (pipx install as root, the documented route); port 61208 is reachable from the sink only.
Network bytes are counted by TCP port (61208); polled traffic is what this row sends.

The network figure is the harness's own poller fetching /api/4/all every 3 s (Glances' refresh period); each reply is about 137 KB, which is the 3.9 GB per 24 h. Scale it to your own polling interval.

Idle CPU depends on the box. This row's runs on box-0 and box-6 show 2.49 and 2.38 % of one vCPU and its run on box-3 1.83 %; each of the four rows measured on these three boxes shows 1.3 to 1.5 times the idle CPU time on box-0 and box-6, and under load this row's runs on box-0, box-3 and box-6 are 1.73, 1.71 and 1.72 %. The published median (2.38 %) is therefore a box-0 or box-6 figure, while every other row was measured on boxes that idle like box-3 (Netdata's run 1 excepted). Why the two boxes differ is not established (`docs/RUN-2026-slot5.md`, "Deviations").
